call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth projected at low to mid-teens with 75-100 bps EBITDA margin expansion.
Domestic business back on track in April after Zuventus restructuring impact in Q4.
Exclusive India partner for Poviztra (rDNA biologic semaglutide); price cut in April 2026 to stay competitive.
Gross margins expected to remain around 60% for FY27.
Partnered with Dr. Reddy's to launch semaglutide in Quebec via Mantra subsidiary in Q2 FY27.
In-licensing accounts for approximately 15% of domestic sales.
Delivered above-guidance FY26 revenue growth of 16.6%, surpassing the US$1 Bn milestone in year one of its five-year plan.
FY26 EBITDA margin improved 83 bps to 19.4% on productivity enhancements and scaling of in-house products.
Partnered with Roche to distribute key CKD, anaemia, and transplant care brands starting Q1FY27.
Filed DMF for HIV drug Lenacapavir, with product registration expected in FY27.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Show cause notice (SCN) under Section 73(1) of the CGST/ MGST Act, 2017 issued in connection with alleged misclassification in outward supply due to HSN and reconciliation of turnover based on TDS Return filed by customers. The general rate of GST on Pharmaceuticals products is @12% and some goods specified in GST Rate Notification 01/2017 are charged to GST @ 5%. The Authority has challenged 5% GST rate and issued SCN for differential rate of 7%. GST impact of issues raised in SCN is Rs. 712.83 million (including interest of Rs. 283.15 million and penalty of Rs. 66.52 million). The Company had submitted reply for the said SCN on 17-10-2025 and personal hearing was granted. Based on the personal hearing, an order has been passed on 17-12-2025. As per the Order, alleged HSN misclassification has been dropped. However, demand confirmed for difference in turnover with TDS Return filed by Customers. The revised demand is Rs. 402.14 million (including interest of Rs. 163.87 million and penalty of Rs. 21.66 million).
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, LTUE604, Pune
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed application for rectification with the Authority.

GST impact of issues raised in SCN is Rs. 532.59 million (including interest of Rs. 210.65 million and penalty of Rs. 52.60 million). operating_notes.text: Mantra Pharma acquired 100% of Cutimed Inc. on April 1, 2026 for up to CAD 5.05 million (₹33.75 Cr) via short-form amalgamation.
Domestic PCPM increased to 7.0 lacs in FY26 with sales growth in line with IPM.
Partnership with Novo Nordisk to market Poviztra (semaglutide brand) and expanded Sanofi partnership for Amaryl and Cetapin.
Domestic field productivity increased to ₹7 lakhs per MR in FY26 from ₹5.4 lakhs two years ago.
In-licensing products contribute approximately 15% to domestic sales.
Partnered with Dr. Reddy's for semaglutide launch in Quebec, Canada.
US FDA cGMP inspection at Sanand formulations facility (May 6–15, 2026) concluded with Form 483 citing 7 procedural observations.
ARV was about two-thirds of Rest of the World revenue in Q1FY27, expected at 50-55% for the full year.
Forex contributed about 6-7% at company level and about 12-13% to international growth in Q1FY27.
India growth split: new launches 1-2%, price 4-5%, rest volume.

timeline.summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals shareholders approved the appointment of Mr. C S Muralidharan as an Independent Director via postal ballot.
Shareholders via postal ballot on April 24, 2026, approved Mr. C S Muralidharan (DIN: 00014740) as Independent Director.
Emcure reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹2,469.70 Cr and PAT of ₹243.74 Cr; recommended ₹3.60 final dividend.
Emcure presented Q4/FY26 results showing full-year revenue crossing $1 Bn (up 16.6% to ₹9,204 Cr) and adjusted PAT up 40.9% to ₹1,008 Cr.
Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited shared the Q4 FY26 earnings call audio recording on May 05, 2026, via its website.
Emcure Pharmaceuticals crossed $1 billion in FY26 revenue and guided for low to mid-teen growth in FY27 with 75-100 bps margin expansion.
Emcure received a US FDA Form 483 with 7 procedural observations for its Sanand formulations facility following an inspection ended May 15, 2026.
Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited’s **Amruta Amrit Yangalwar** schedules analyst/investor meetings on May 26–27, June 1, and June 9, 2026, in Mumbai and virtual formats.
